earnings.title: Media Relations:
highlights: Skyworks Standalone Revenue of $1.046 Billion, GAAP Diluted EPS of $0.15 and Non-GAAP Diluted EPS of $1.28
Skyworks’ GAAP diluted earnings per share were $0.15 and non-GAAP diluted earnings per share were $1.28.
For fiscal year 2026, Skyworks’ revenue was $3.96 billion, with GAAP diluted earnings per share of $1.14 and non-GAAP diluted earnings per share of $5.05.
Skyworks’ revenue for its fourth fiscal quarter of 2026 was $1,046 million.

quotes.text: Because our combination with Qorvo closed after the end of our fiscal fourth quarter, our reported September-quarter results are Skyworks standalone.
quotes.by: Philip Carter, chief financial officer and senior vice president of Skyworks

quotes.text: For the December quarter, our first as a combined company, we anticipate revenue of $1.80 billion to $1.90 billion. At the midpoint, this includes approximately $1.07 billion from legacy Skyworks and approximately $780 million from legacy Qorvo; this is the last quarter in which we will provide this split.

outlook: We expect Diversified Growth Markets revenue to grow in the low single digits sequentially, despite the extra week in the prior quarter, and in the high single to low double digits year-over-year on a combined basis, representing more than 40 percent of sales, led by data center and defense.

items.heading: Completion of the proposed transaction with Qorvo may be delayed or not occur at all for a variety of reasons, including that the Merger Agreement is terminated, and the failure to complete the Mergers could adversely affect our business, results of operations, financial condition, and the market price of our common stock.
items.group: Risks Associated with the Proposed Transaction with Qorvo

items.heading: Failure to realize the benefits expected from the Mergers could adversely affect our business, results of operations, and financial condition.
items.group: Risks Associated with the Proposed Transaction with Qorvo

items.heading: Efforts to complete the Mergers could disrupt our relationships with third parties and employees, divert management’s attention, or result in negative publicity or legal proceedings, any of which could adversely impact our operating results and ongoing business.
items.group: Risks Associated with the Proposed Transaction with Qorvo

items.heading: The Merger Agreement contains provisions that limit our ability to pursue alternative transactions to the Mergers which could discourage a potential third party from making an alternative transaction proposal.
items.group: Risks Associated with the Proposed Transaction with Qorvo

items.heading: While the Merger Agreement is in effect, we are subject to restrictions on our business activities.
items.group: Risks Associated with the Proposed Transaction with Qorvo

items.heading: The Mergers will require us to incur substantial additional indebtedness, which could reduce our flexibility to operate our business and negatively affect our financial condition, and increase the risks associated with our level of indebtedness.
